Pool Shell Manufacturer, Model, and Color Verified
Feature locations (tanning ledge, bench, steps, spa)
Spa Shell Manufacturer, Model, and Color Verified (if applicable)
Shell production lead time and delivery date confirmed
Salt or chlorine chlorinator (one or the other)
Construction Tote for supplies onsite - all mechanical instruction books for Pool School
D2 Pool Sign in the Yard
PreCon Meeting PM and Dig Team>digsheet/plan view
Crane access route to backyard verified
Site Prep and Demo (existing fence etc)
Shell delivery date confirmed with manufacturer/hauler
Backfill material (per shell manufacturer spec - crushed stone or flowable fill)
Overhead obstruction check for crane (power lines, trees)
Stake Perimeter (per shell footprint plus working clearance)
Feature layout (spa, tanning ledge, water features)
Overdig requirements (shell width plus working space, typically 12-18" per side)
Dig depth calculations (shell depth plus base material thickness)
Excavation dimension check against shell shop drawing
Verify hole dimensions match shell shop drawing
Install crushed stone/gravel base (per shell manufacturer spec, typically 4-6 in)
Plumbing stub-out locations marked prior to shell set
Shell serial number/model verified against order
Shell braced at walls, steps, and benches per manufacturer spec
Plumbing plan reviewed against shell fitting locations
Shell plumbed and squared to layout stakes
Shell lifted and set into excavation
Bonding wire attached to shell bonding studs
Equipotential bonding grid installed around perimeter
Equipment pad base/slab poured or set
Begin backfilling in lifts, alternating with rising water level
Backfill material staged (crushed stone or flowable fill per manufacturer spec)
Begin filling shell with water (initial few inches)
Verify shell walls are straight and true (no bowing)
Monitor shell walls for movement/distortion throughout process
Continue matched lifts until backfill reaches grade and water reaches skimmer level
Compact backfill in lifts (hand tamp near walls; no heavy equipment against shell)
Concrete collar/bond beam formed around shell perimeter (if required by design)
Pattern/material selected and approved by customer
Review Operation and Layout of Equipment with Installation Team
Auto Leveler and Pool Drain verification
Salt or Chlorinate Pool per startup schedule
Remove excess materials and construction debris
Rough grade perimeter for positive drainage
Remove rock and debris from grade
Erosion control blanket on slopes (as needed)
Verify rough grade/drainage away from structures
Plant, shrub, and sprinkler head replacement as needed
